sources.title: Corpus Verifier Checkpoint 01 — DATA_CONTRACT.md
sources.usage: Defines the existing Corpus Pane evidence layers, skeleton identity, review semantics, named configurations, comparison decisions, persistence and update boundaries.
sources.notes: Primary authority for what the current Corpus Pane already records versus what remains future work.

sources.title: Adventure Studio universal skeleton v1.2.0
sources.usage: Canonical shared 2D anatomical IDs, region hierarchy, face slots, coordinate convention and visibility states.

sources.title: gray base mannequin anatomical rig — uploaded doll_rig_v0_4_13(1).json
sources.usage: Existing articulated/structural layer roles, pivots, anchors, parent links, semantic sockets, mirroring behavior and layer-order groups.

sources.title: Corpus Library Starter Pass 01
sources.usage: Current five-clip seed library, 18 regional configurations, six comparisons, separate head-direction observation limitation.

sources.title: MakeHuman Community — License
sources.license: Core assets CC0; MPFB source GPL; MakeHuman source AGPL
sources.usage: Supports using MakeHuman core assets as optional reference material while keeping software-code licensing separate.
sources.ingestPolicy: May use CC0 core assets in a later explicit reference-generation pass. Do not copy GPL/AGPL source into Corpus Pane by default.

sources.title: MakeHuman Community — Saving and loading MPFB poses
sources.usage: Supports reusable full and partial poses, with same-rig-type restriction and shape-transfer caveats.
sources.ingestPolicy: Use as design/reference guidance; do not assume MPFB pose files are directly compatible with Corpus Pane.

sources.title: MakeHuman Community — Rigging and posing developer notes
sources.usage: Supports rig definitions in JSON and fitting bone positions to body shape through explicit strategies.
sources.ingestPolicy: Use concepts and optionally generated CC0 reference assets; no direct schema substitution.

sources.title: Esoteric Software — Spine Mix-and-Match example
sources.usage: Construction patterns for modular 2D characters: separate items, conditional bones/constraints, attachment behavior and limited perspective/depth controls.
sources.ingestPolicy: Study concepts only in this knowledge package. Do not bundle Spine project files, runtime code or art.

sources.title: Esoteric Software — Spine JSON export format
sources.usage: Supports clear separation of bones, slots, attachments, draw order and constraints.
sources.ingestPolicy: Use as design vocabulary only; do not make Corpus Pane dependent on Spine format.

sources.title: Esoteric Software — Spine Editor License Agreement
sources.usage: Licensing boundary for Spine runtimes and derivative integration.
sources.ingestPolicy: No Spine runtime or example project is bundled in this package.

sources.title: Google ML Kit — Pose classification options
sources.usage: Supports normalization and nearest-neighbor comparison of pose landmarks, and warns that camera angle matters.
sources.ingestPolicy: Adapt method to Corpus Pane regions and view labels. Do not silently mirror anatomical left/right.

sources.title: Google ML Kit — Pose detection
sources.usage: 33-point pose concept, per-landmark in-frame likelihood and experimental Z hint that is not true 3D.
sources.ingestPolicy: Depth-like values, if ever added, remain optional provenance/hints and never override checked 2D evidence.

sources.title: TensorFlow Hub — MoveNet pose detection
sources.usage: Documents MoveNet 17-keypoint topology used as one detector input to the current tracker.
sources.ingestPolicy: Detector output is evidence, not verification; derived Corpus Pane controls remain separately labeled.

sources.title: CMU Graphics Lab Motion Capture Database
sources.license: Free for use; may be included in commercially sold products; may not be resold directly even in converted form; site asks not to crawl.
sources.usage: Potential later source of movement gaps, not a replacement anatomy standard.
sources.ingestPolicy: Do not bundle raw or converted CMU motion data in this knowledge package. Future import must preserve source and licensing.

sources.title: Google ML Kit Samples — Apache 2.0 license
sources.usage: Confirms sample-code licensing if a later implementation deliberately adapts sample logic.
sources.ingestPolicy: No external code is copied into this package.
